description: Implementation of LoanDelinquencyDomainService for calculating overdue and delinquency data for loans, including installment-level details, overdue days, and handling chargeback transactions.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyDomainServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing loan delinquency calculations, including overdue and delinquency data at loan and installment levels.

methods.name: getOverdueCollectionData
methods.description: Calculates overdue collection data for a loan, including overdue days, amounts, and delinquency start date.

methods.name: getLoanDelinquencyData
methods.description: Provides comprehensive delinquency data for a loan, including installment-level details if enabled.

methods.name: getInstallmentOverdueCollectionData
methods.description: Retrieves overdue collection data for a specific installment.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyDataForOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Calculates delinquency details for an overdue installment, considering chargeback transactions.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyDataForNonOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Calculates delinquency details for a non-overdue installment, considering chargeback transactions.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyDataForOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Calculates overdue installment delinquency data, including outstanding amounts and overdue date.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyDataForNonOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Calculates non-overdue installment delinquency data, including outstanding amounts and overdue date.

methods.name: calculateAndSetDelinquentDays
methods.description: Calculates and sets the number of delinquent days, considering overdue days, paused days, and grace period.
